description:
What is This Part?
These Suzuki OEM parts are the Leaf Spring Spacers for the Front & Rear Shackles
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 4 – Spacers, Leaf Spring Bolts
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki Sj410 1980 – 1984 All Models
